description: Legal Affairs Department - Gambling Regulatory Authority Act, No. 17 of 2025. Order under Sub Section (2) of Section 1.
categorisation: The gazette content is an order that brings a specific Act (the Gambling Regulatory Authority Act, No. 17 of 2025) into operation. It is a formal legal/regulatory instrument issued under the authority of the Constitution and the Act itself. While it is signed by the President, the core subject matter is the commencement of legislation, not a government personnel appointment or a description of government structure/portfolios. Therefore, it falls under the specialized category for Legal/Regulatory Gazettes.
